text: もし　２ばんどうろに　いったら　さがして　みてよ！

structure.jp: もし　２ばんどうろに　いったら

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: The past form with ら added means 'if' or 'when' that happens. いったら = 'if you go'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: The て-form followed by みる means to try doing something and see how it goes. さがして　みて = 'try looking for him'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form on its own at the end is a casual request, short for てください. さがして　みて = 'try looking, will you'.
